I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It is a 1280px `#component` with static HTML and CSS only. The tokens it uses are copied inline from `tokens.css`, in both day and dusk values.

- **Layout:** the page is white, in one centered column up to 1120px wide. The "Requests" heading and the primary "New Request" button are in the top row. Below that are the search field and the filters, then the table in a card.
- **Filters:** "All" is the Secondary button (1.5px ink border) and is marked `aria-pressed="true"`. "Open" and "Closed" are Quiet buttons. I did this because DESIGN.md allows one Primary button per screen and no other button styles.
- **Table:** the header uses the label style and the rows are 52px with dividers. Status values are accent-tint pills. Priority and Requester are plain text.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so they fall back to `system-ui` here. The heading will look different from the intended Unbounded Light until those fonts are available.
